correctness.rationale: For E:y²=x³−1 and T=(0,i), direct chord-addition algebra yields x(P)x(P+T)x(P−T)=4, independent of chosen shift. Divisor of x(P+Q) is [T−Q]+[−T−Q]−2[−Q]. On each three-element H-orbit of points, valuation columns form the 3×3 matrix with diagonal −2 and off-diagonal 1; any two columns have unit 2×2 determinant 3 modulo m, while all three sum to zero and constant product is a true mth power over C. Disjoint H-cosets have disjoint divisor support. Thus exactly t independent Kummer relations, generic compositum group (Z/m)^{r−t} and generic tensor product splits into m^t fields. At each of 3c distinct branch points at least one valuation is coprime to m (m odd prime to 3), giving inertia m; Riemann–Hurwitz over elliptic base gives genus 1+(3c/2)m^{r−t−1}(m−1) per normalization component. Independently checked identity modulo Weierstrass polynomial and all modular relation kernels for m=5,7,11,13, including explicit cases (occupancies [1,1],[2],[3],[3,1]). The field-theoretic proof, not these finite checks, establishes every allowed m and shift pattern.
